highlights.description: Policies compiled from authorization decisions use strict allowlists, so a decision that grants nothing denies every query

security.description: `authz.PolicyFromDecision` turned a decision that allowed no entity into a policy with empty allowlists, which `CheckPolicy` and `CheckAnalysisPolicy` read as unrestricted; the policy now uses strict allowlists, so a decision that grants nothing denies every query
`CheckPolicy` checked only the `FROM` entity against `AllowedEntities`, not joined entities

added.description: `Policy.StrictAllowlists` makes `AllowedEntities` and `Fields` strict allowlists even when empty

documentation.description: Authorization guide points to SystemForge's `authzguardsql` adapter

added.description: Built-in SQL compiler (`Compile`) emitting parameterized SQL for SQLite, Postgres, and MySQL from a validated AST, with dialect-specific JSON path extraction on `FieldJSON` columns
`Config` with `NewUntrustedConfig` and `NewTrustedConfig` trust profiles running parse, validate, policy, and compile in one step
Field data classification (`ClassPII`, `ClassSecret`) with `Config.AllowPII` and `Config.AllowSecret`; denied fields read as unknown fields
`IsSafeIdentifier` and `Schema.ValidateIdentifiers` identifier lockdown, on by default and disabled with `AllowUnsafeIdentifiers`
`Insert`, `Update`, and `Delete` mutation builders with deny-by-default `Field.Writable`, required WHERE, and condition helpers (`Eq`, `In`, `And`, `Or`, `Not`, and others)
`Config.RowScope`, `ScopeEquals`, and `RequireRowScope` for mandatory tenant/ownership predicates ANDed into every compiled SELECT, UPDATE, and DELETE

`ClassInternal` data class and `Config.AllowInternal`: internal fields are stripped from the effective schema (reading as unknown fields) unless allowed; off in the untrusted profile, on in the trusted profile

`FromCatalog` builds a `Schema` from a `datacatalog` catalog, validating it and mapping visibility, PII, and secret tags to the single most restrictive `Field.Class`, with `WithWritable` and `WithNonFilterable` options
Postgres casts JSON-path extractions to `numeric`/`boolean` for numeric and boolean comparisons and `SUM`/`AVG`, so JSON numeric filters execute
`CompileOptions.ScopeSchema`: the row-scope predicate resolves against the full schema, so a scope may reference a column hidden from callers
`Insert` stamps the row scope's equality terms onto the new row, and `Insert`/`Update` reject assignment to scope columns

changed.description: Minimum Go version raised from 1.23 to 1.25, as required by the new `github.com/grokify/datacatalog` dependency
JSON path segments are restricted to ASCII letters, digits, and underscore, matching identifier lockdown

highlights.description: Project renamed from GrokifyQL to GuardSQL to better describe the SQL safety and policy enforcement mission

breaking.description: Go module path changed from `github.com/grokify/grokifyql` to `github.com/grokify/guardsql`
Go package name changed from `grokifyql` to `guardsql`
Formatter command path changed from `cmd/grokifyqlfmt` to `cmd/guardsqlfmt`
TypeScript package name changed from `@grokify/grokifyql` to `@grokify/guardsql`
Optional SystemForge adapter module changed from `github.com/grokify/grokifyql/authzsystemforge` to `github.com/grokify/guardsql/authzsystemforge`

changed.description: Updated README, MkDocs site metadata, release notes, changelog links, examples, package comments, tests, and generated TypeScript distribution files for the GuardSQL name
Renamed public TypeScript parse error type from `GrokifyQLParseError` to `GuardSQLParseError`

upgradeGuide.description: Update Go imports from `github.com/grokify/grokifyql` to `github.com/grokify/guardsql` and rename local package aliases from `grokifyql` to `guardsql` where used
Update formatter invocations from `go run ./cmd/grokifyqlfmt` to `go run ./cmd/guardsqlfmt`

highlights.description: Initial GuardSQL release with a SaaS-safe parser, AST, schema validation, policy checks, formatter, and in-memory evaluator
Browser-side TypeScript package and optional SystemForge authorization adapter for application integrations

added.description: Read-only GuardSQL parser and AST for SELECT/FROM/WHERE/GROUP BY/HAVING/ORDER BY/LIMIT, CTEs, joins, nested sources, aggregate functions, and PRIORITIZE BY
Schema validation, static linting, policy checks, query analysis, safe analytics policy defaults, and field requirement extraction
In-memory evaluator for single-source filtering, grouping, aggregates, HAVING, ordering, limits, and projection
Dependency-free formatter and guardsqlfmt CLI for canonical query output, single-line formatting, and ANSI highlighting
Lightweight authorization decision helpers and optional nested SystemForge authorization adapter module
Browser-oriented TypeScript package with lexer, parser, formatter, schema validation, policy checks, tests, and generated distribution files

fixed.description: Reject AS without a following alias so malformed source aliases fail parsing and golangci-lint unparam remains clean

documentation.description: Documented query language syntax, request pipeline, schema validation, policy model, authorization, backend execution, integrations, development, and security hardening guidance

build.description: Added GitHub Actions workflows for Go CI, linting, CodeQL, Dependabot, repository metadata, and license
